description: This file defines the CordRepRing class, a data structure for managing ring buffers of CordRep nodes, including methods for creation, modification, and querying of ring buffers used in string data management within the Abseil library.

classes.name: CordRepRing
classes.description: A class representing a ring buffer of CordRep nodes, supporting operations like append, prepend, subring extraction, and capacity management for efficient string data handling.

classes.name: CordRepRing::Position
classes.description: A struct representing a position within the ring buffer, including node index and offset.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates a new ring buffer from a given CordRep node, adopting its reference.

methods.name: Append
methods.description: Appends a CordRep node or string data to the ring buffer.

methods.name: Prepend
methods.description: Prepends a CordRep node or string data to the ring buffer.

methods.name: SubRing
methods.description: Returns a subring of the current ring buffer starting at a given offset with specified length.

methods.name: RemoveSuffix
methods.description: Removes a specified number of bytes from the end of the ring buffer.

methods.name: RemovePrefix
methods.description: Removes a specified number of bytes from the beginning of the ring buffer.

methods.name: GetCharacter
methods.description: Returns the character at a specific offset within the ring buffer.
